prompt: I'm a technical writer in India with contributions tracked in JIRA tasks over the past 2 years. I have my outdated resume, a PDF from my manager showing my Betterworks performance review with ratings on clarity and technical depth, and an old CV. I need a modern, ATS-friendly resume for job applications. Please generate both Markdown and HTML versions that highlight my impact through quantified metrics and showcase my portfolio potential.

assertions.name: resume-markdown-exists
assertions.description: Outputs include a resume.md file in ATS-optimized Markdown

assertions.name: resume-html-exists
assertions.description: Outputs include a valid, responsive resume.html file for GitHub hosting

assertions.name: jira-metrics-quantified
assertions.description: Resume includes quantified JIRA metrics (45 tasks, 3-day turnaround, etc.)

assertions.name: clarity-improvement-featured
assertions.description: Highlights clarity score improvement (3.5 → 4.3/5, 23% improvement) from Betterworks

assertions.name: vague-language-eliminated
assertions.description: Original vague statements ('Write API documentation') are transformed into specific achievements with metrics

assertions.name: performance-rating-integrated
assertions.description: Incorporates Betterworks ratings (4.2/5 overall, 4.5/5 attention to detail) as credibility signals

assertions.name: growth-trajectory-clear
assertions.description: Resume shows clear growth trajectory and positive performance trend (2020 CV → 2024 achievements)

assertions.name: portfolio-placeholders
assertions.description: Includes portfolio/GitHub section with placeholders for future documentation samples

assertions.name: ats-optimization-verified
assertions.description: Markdown follows ATS best practices: single column, no tables, standard fonts, quantified content

assertions.name: high-value-keywords-present
assertions.description: Includes technical keywords valuable for market positioning (Git, Markdown, Docusaurus, API, CI/CD)
